title: Factory policy (policies/default.yaml, .factory/policy.yaml)
description: A product policy can only tighten the default: limits take the lower value, lists are added to.

max_attempts.description: Build attempts per item before it is blocked.

max_tokens_per_item.description: Tokens per item, all steps and attempts.

denied_commands.description: Command prefixes no agent may run.

approval_paths.description: Glob patterns. An item whose diff touches one is flagged for the user's attention before approval.

protected_paths.description: Glob patterns no agent may change. A diff that touches one blocks the item.
